description: RISMEAU measures pharmaceuticals, biocides and environmental effects associated with applying urban sludge and manure to land. The SIPIBEL research consortium studies the Arve catchment in the French Alps using soil, leachate, organic-waste, plant and earthworm samples. The collection reports 26,217 measurements spanning physicochemical variables, contaminant concentrations, bioassays and antimicrobial-resistance indicators. Coverage is the Arve catchment, with sampling from November 2019 to December 2022. Zenodo provides a 7z archive with CSV sampling-point, method, sample and measurement tables and PDF documentation, free under CC BY 4.0. The repository counts 351 samples while the article counts 348; this discrepancy and experimental land-spreading conditions are limitations. Modellers could calibrate pollutant-transfer or waste-management impact simulations. model-epa-swmm is a related urban-water tool, although soil and biological endpoints require additional modelling components. The archive continues an earlier deposit and is recorded as one collection here. No sample measurements or documentation file was downloaded.
